observations.source: I am going to Alice's birthday.
observations.translation: Estoy yendo al cumpleaños de Alice.
observations.note: Possessive person preserved; birthday construction has an intelligible full target.

observations.source: We are going to my friend's birthday.
observations.translation: Estamos yendo al cumpleaños de mi amigo.
observations.note: Possessive friend construction preserved; Spanish masculine default is not source evidence of friend gender.
book is tagged noun and transferred to libro.

observations.source: Please book a table for two.
observations.translation: Complacer reservar una mesa para dos.
observations.note: book is tagged verb and transferred to reservar, but polite Please is wrongly tagged as a lexical verb and becomes Complacer.

observations.note: perro caliente is an attested regional food expression; do not reject it solely because its component words also mean dog/hot.
Literal hot dog versus food expression remains ambiguous; no confident correctness judgment from spelling alone.
